description: YCB-Video BOP test set - 12 test scenes (48-59), 21 unique objects

preprocessing.description: Square resize with padding to maintain aspect ratio. Depth scale 10000 converts 0.1mm to m.

camera.description: Per-frame camera intrinsics loaded from scene_camera.json (BOP format). Intrinsics vary per frame.

mesh_scale_description: BOP meshes are in millimeters, convert to meters for pose evaluation

objects.description: 21 everyday objects with category_id naming (e.g., can_1) for pipeline compatibility

format.description: BOP19 format with visible masks and GT poses in JSON

test_set.description: BOP curated test set with 75 frames per scene (900 total)

notes: CRITICAL: Depth maps are in PNG format with 0.1mm scale (uint16, use depth_scale=10000.0)
GT poses in scene_gt.json: cam_R_m2c (flattened 3x3), cam_t_m2c (mm units)
Masks are instance-level BOP format: mask_visib/{frame:06d}_{instance:06d}.png
Category mapping for partonomy pipeline in data/ycbv/ycbv_object_categories.txt
Object naming: category_id format (can_1, scissors_17) for partonomy compatibility
BOP names (002_master_chef_can, 037_scissors) stored in frame_info for reference
Unlike TYOL, YCB-V has 21 unique objects (not categories with multiple instances)
One2Any's sampling strategy: first occurrence per object per scene becomes reference
